_comment: The live sale, as data. scripts/verify-prices.mjs renders this into README.md between the SALE markers and REMOVES it once `end` passes. Set `sale` to null when nothing is running. `codes` may be empty; `beatsEveryday: false` swaps the stock stacking line for `compare`. Write these strings the way you'd tell a friend: say the deal, the price, who should skip it, then stop. No narrating the announcement, no explaining the automation.

sale.name: Back to School sale
sale.headline: 35% off certifications with `SEPT26BTS35`, or 40% off bundles and instructor-led training with `SEPT26BTS40`
sale.bannerAlt: Linux Foundation Back to School sale, ends September 22: up to 40% off training and certifications
sale.compare: This one beats `RUSHABH30` on everything: 35% on a single exam, 40% on the bundles, against the code's 30%. They don't stack, so use the sale code until September 22 and `RUSHABH30` after that.

bundles.label: CKA, CKAD, CKS or LFCS: ~~$445~~ **$289** with `SEPT26BTS35`
KCNA, KCSA, PCA, OTCA, LFCA and the other associate exams: ~~$250~~ **$163** with `SEPT26BTS35`
Kubestronaut bundle (KCNA, KCSA, CKA, CKAD, CKS): ~~$1645~~ **$987** with `SEPT26BTS40`
CKA + CKAD + CKS exam bundle: ~~$1245~~ **$747** with `SEPT26BTS40`

sale.bundleIntro: What they cost with the sale on, read off the promo page:
sale.dateCaveat: Runs until 23:59 UTC on September 22, which is 5:29 AM IST on the 23rd. New and individual purchases only, not renewals. Does not apply to THRIVE-ONE subscriptions, the Yocto LFD461-JP course, or any FinOps certification.
